phase: Phase 3 — Build Beautiful Websites with CSS
description: Make buttons react when users hover.
definition: The hover selector styles an element while a pointer rests over it.
rule: Combine a hover rule with a transition for a smooth change.
tip: Focus visible can provide a matching cue for keyboard users.
caution: Hover is not reliable on touchscreens; keep essential actions accessible.
exercise: Add hover and keyboard focus styles to one button.
